criteria.criterion: A test (cargo test) shows the configured model and effort for each role reach the claude driver as CLI arguments and appear on that invocation's record.
criteria.evidence: In claude.rs, `the_model_and_effort_of_an_invocation_reach_the_command_line` checks the value after `--model` and after `--effort` for three model/effort pairs, and it passes. In drain.rs, `every_role_runs_at_its_configured_model_and_effort_and_the_record_names_both` runs a whole job and checks that the reader, producer and verifier records carry the configured model and effort; it passes. Every role's spec gets its effort from `effort_for(role)` in reading.rs `agent_spec`.
commands: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test drain -- hard_reading every_role_runs

criteria.criterion: A test (cargo test) shows a reading marking a job hard gets the stronger producer model or effort with its reason recorded, while an ordinary reading keeps the configured default and records no escalation reason.
criteria.evidence: `a_hard_reading_gets_the_stronger_producer_setting_with_its_reason_and_an_ordinary_one_keeps_the_default` passes. A hard reading gets `hard_producer_model` and `hard_producer_effort` with its reason on the reading, and the producer's invocation record carries the raised effort, not the default. A null reason and a whitespace-only reason both keep haiku at the default effort, with `hard_reason` and `producer_effort` left as None.
commands: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test drain -- hard_reading every_role_runs

criteria.criterion: A test (cargo test) shows athena status output lists first-pass verification rate, landed share and cost per landed job per producer model and effort. A bucket with no landed jobs shows no division by zero and no false success.
criteria.evidence: `producer_settings_split_first_pass_landed_share_and_cost_by_model_and_effort` checks the buckets for medium, high and unrecorded effort. For the high bucket, where nothing landed: landed_share is 0, cost_per_landed is None, and first_pass_rate is 0. The display test checks the rendered line, 'landed 0% (0 of 4) · cost per landed job n/a', and 'first-pass n/a' when nothing was verified. `StatusView` includes `producer_settings`. Both tests pass.

criteria.criterion: athena.toml (listed as a deliverable) sets model and effort for reader, producer and verifier, plus the hard-job producer setting. config.rs parses them and rejects unknown effort values. Older records without effort still load.

findings.summary: Nobody checked that the pinned Claude Code version accepts `--effort`
findings.evidence: The driver now always passes `--effort`. D136 itself says 'that this version accepts `--effort` was not checked here, because no agent was run.' If the pinned CLI rejects the flag, every invocation would fail. This needs a live check before release.

summary: The change does what the accepted reading asks. In `athena.toml`, `[models]` now sets an effort for the reader, producer and verifier, plus a hard-job producer setting. `config.rs` refuses any effort outside low, medium, high, xhigh and max. The claude driver passes `--effort` next to `--model`. Every invocation record now carries an optional `effort` field, so older records still load. The reader's output gains a `hard_reason` field. A reading with a reason gets `hard_producer_model` and `hard_producer_effort`, and the reading records both the reason and the raised effort. An ordinary reading keeps the default and records neither. `athena status` shows the first-pass verification rate, landed share and cost per landed job for each producer model and effort, and shows "n/a" instead of dividing by zero. I ran every new targeted test and all pass. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test runs passed. I found two minor points. First, several changed files are not on the deliverables list, though each was needed to deliver the feature. Second, nobody checked that the pinned Claude Code version accepts `--effort`; the decision entry says so itself.
